verdict.rationale: Neon exposes real technical levers for retention/deletion control — branch TTLs and auto-expiring branches declared in neon.ts, automated cleanup of ephemeral per-agent projects, a documented 72-hour expiry/claim window for unclaimed agent-provisioned projects, instant restore/snapshot mechanics, and revocable/scoped API keys — and it states that its SQL-editor AI feature shares schema but 'no actual data' with the LLM. However there is no dedicated privacy/compliance documentation (GDPR/CCPA-style data deletion policy, account/data export-and-delete workflow, retention SLAs) tying these mechanisms together into a coherent 'control your data retention and deletion' story for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion policy or compliance docs, user-facing account/data deletion workflow, audit log of deletions, independent confirmation these mechanisms satisfy privacy requirements.
